definitions.explanation: Describes flowers whose blossoms have many overlapping petals, or things arranged in many layers. Contrasted with {一重|ひとえ} (single-petaled, single-layered). Here {八|はち} ("eight") stands for "many."

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八重|やえ}だ。
examples.english: This flower is a double (multi-petaled) variety.
Double plum blossoms bloomed in the garden.

examples.japanese: {八重|やえ}{咲|ざ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Double-flowering varieties have many petals and look gorgeous.

notes:
Refers to blossoms with many overlapping petals, contrasted with ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧ (single-petaled). Also means "multi-layered" or "eightfold" more generally, where ⟦{八|はち}→八：00698_hachi⟧ ("eight") simply signals "many."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{八重桜|やえざくら}→八重桜：29806_yaezakura⟧: double cherry blossom
- {八重|やえ}{咲|ざ}き: double-flowering (variety)
- {八重|やえ}{歯|ば}: snaggletooth (a tooth doubled over another)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧: single-petaled; single layer — the opposite; one layer of petals
